cosmetic_allow_list.silk_edge_clearance: silkscreen close to the board edge
cosmetic_allow_list.silk_over_copper: silkscreen clipped by solder mask openings
cosmetic_allow_list.text_height: text smaller than the fab's legibility limit
cosmetic_allow_list.text_thickness: text stroke thinner than the fab's legibility limit

custom_rules: gleda min track width of net class Default
gleda min track width of net class CamPower
gleda min track width of net class Fine
gleda min track width of net class Power
gleda fine class CamPower outside the fine areas
gleda fine class Fine outside the fine areas
gl1 zone clearance for every zone

lib_footprint_issues.reason: headless runs have no global footprint library table, so every footprint would be flagged 'library not found'

lib_footprint_mismatch.reason: placed footprints legitimately differ from their library copy (hidden reference, BOM properties), which KiCad reports for every generated footprint
